name: Asagaya
tagline: Shinjuku in 11 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, where JR East run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 30 minutes to Otemachi, 11 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 41 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 41 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38.6 m to 45.3 m, a difference of 6.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 21 clinics and 27 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 河北総合病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 清川病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. JR Chuo Rapid Line run through it. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) also call here. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: JR Chuo Rapid Line runs at 158% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中野→新宿, which this station is not on. JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) runs at 151%. Its busiest stretch is 錦糸町→両国, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Asagaya is ahead on rail connections and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Asagaya. Minami-Asagaya has only the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, so Asagaya is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Minami-Asagaya takes 7 minutes longer. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Koenji; for safety, Asagaya.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Asagaya in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Asagaya. To Toranomon, for instance, Koenji is 3 minutes quicker. On what it offers families, Asagaya comes out ahead.

notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: 中杉通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
